spiritual_reading:
Within the outermost degree, the Divine arranged a complete support for all subsequent order, establishing a full structure of stability from the highest down to the lowest.

First, Divine truth in its fullness was brought into manifestation as the perfect form in which all wisdom and use are held together. By an immediate Divine commission it was placed in the region where ultimates are governed. It was extended so that the natural degree might be opened upward to the spiritual, and so that what is lowest could receive what is highest. In this way it sustained the whole complex of ordered states, becoming the primary support through which all powers are borne and held in their right connection. By the steadfastness of this Divine truth, the whole system was made upright, and everything within it was fixed in place, both what is interior and what is exterior.

Second, a new and enlightened natural degree was established above the former natural degree that had been immersed in falsity. This higher natural was set so as to rest upon and restrain the lower, and by doing so it broke the imposed closures that held a sufficient series of interior receptacles in the intention of spiritual death. It instituted stability—indeed stability made strong—over the falsified natural, and extended this ordering beyond it so that the lower could no longer dominate. Thus it removed, subdued, and permanently restrained the deepest originating principle of spiritual death.

These, together with a third support not clearly expressed in the given portion, formed the complete set of fundamental stabilizations: a full provision established in confidence through three discrete degrees, honored because they secure the whole. They were arranged and fixed in their own degrees within these same outer worlds, and made immovable according to the Divine will.

fills.notes: The first ‘rock’ is explicitly the axial support in the outer worlds: the upright stabilizing truth that holds the whole in connection. “Pillar” matches the correspondential function (support, vertical conjunction of higher and lower) and the surrounding title “of Glory.”

The commission is immediate: the Perfect Man is “summoned by the glorious Ambassador,” i.e., set in manifestation through a delegated proceeding. This keeps the impersonal cosmological register while preserving the agency-chain required by the narrative.

The sentence requires simple coordination: “He set it in this zone; and brought forth its base …” The action is one continuous establishing and extending downward-to-upward, matching the spiritual description of opening the natural upward to the spiritual.

“These selfsame worlds” points back to the already-mentioned ‘outer worlds’ as the fixed ultimate plane in which the three supports are distributed. It preserves the structural, non-exhortatory substrate style.

assessment: Most lacunae are trivial letter-restorations and are recoverable with high certainty. The only substantive gap (¶3 #3) is constrained by the correspondential sequence of establishing then extending the base from earth to heaven; a simple connective (“and”) best fits the oldest, impersonal cosmological register.
